mapper.sql: mp.id, mp.title, mp.message, mp.city_id, mp.create_time, mp.update_time, ch.name AS city_name, ct.city_number
FROM medical_policy mp LEFT JOIN city ct ON mp.city_id = ct.city_id LEFT JOIN china ch ON ct.city_number = ch.id
mapper.select:
SELECT mp.id, mp.title, mp.message, mp.city_id, mp.create_time, mp.update_time, (SELECT ch.name FROM city ct2 LEFT JOIN china ch ON ct2.city_number = ch.id WHERE ct2.city_id = mp.city_id) AS city_name, (SELECT ct3.city_number FROM city ct3 WHERE ct3.city_id = mp.city_id) AS city_number FROM medical_policy mp WHERE 1=1
AND mp.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND mp.city_id = #{cityId}
ORDER BY mp.create_time DESC

SELECT mp.id, mp.title, mp.message, mp.city_id, mp.create_time, mp.update_time, ch.name AS city_name, ct.city_number FROM medical_policy mp LEFT JOIN city ct ON mp.city_id = ct.city_id LEFT JOIN china ch ON ct.city_number = ch.id WHERE mp.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_policy (title, message, city_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{message}, #{cityId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT mp.id, mp.title, mp.message, mp.city_id, mp.create_time, mp.update_time, (SELECT ch.name FROM city ct2 LEFT JOIN china ch ON ct2.city_number = ch.id WHERE ct2.city_id = mp.city_id) AS city_name, (SELECT ct3.city_number FROM city ct3 WHERE ct3.city_id = mp.city_id) AS city_number FROM medical_policy mp ORDER BY mp.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT ct.city_id, ch.name AS city_name, ct.city_number FROM city ct LEFT JOIN china ch ON ct.city_number = ch.id ORDER BY ct.city_id ASC
